project.name: analyze
project.description: Django-style library loans and fees application with service, repository, and template layers

nodes.name: detail.html
nodes.summary: Django template showing a loan's late fee (due date, days late, amount) and either the payment result or the payment form.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends base.html and conditionally includes partials via {% include ... with %}.

tour.title: Project Overview: Loans & Fees
tour.description: A Django app for lending library books and charging late fees. Two apps (loans, fees) share a layered, ports-and-adapters design. Start at the URL routes of the loans app, the entry point.

tour.title: Loan Routing and Views
tour.description: URLs map to views that handle plain-text API endpoints and HTML pages for lending, returning and listing loans.

tour.title: Loan Domain Services
tour.description: LoanApplication is framework-free business logic that depends on abstract ports (repository, clock) rather than Django.
tour.languageLesson: Python Protocol classes define structural interfaces (ports) so domain code can be tested without Django.

tour.title: Persistence and Models
tour.description: The Loan model, its migration (with seed data) and the Django ORM repository implement the storage port with atomic operations.

tour.title: Wiring It Together
tour.description: Composition roots and SystemClock plug concrete adapters into the domain services.

tour.title: Late Fees Domain
tour.description: FeeApplication computes late fees from loans using ports for the repository, clock and payment gateway.

tour.title: Fee Adapters
tour.description: A Django repository finds loans for the fees domain, and an HTTP adapter charges the external payment gateway without following redirects.

tour.title: Fee Routes and Views
tour.description: Fee URLs and views expose fee lookup and payment as text endpoints and HTML pages.

tour.title: Templates and HTMX
tour.description: A base layout is extended by loan and fee pages; HTMX partials update forms and statuses in place.
